methodology: Extracted from per-passage terminology arrays in all 473 extraction records. Each term includes verbatim Arabic, transliteration, editorial gloss, verse occurrences, and surah distribution.

ajal-allah.gloss: the time set by Allah (editorial gloss)

alif-lam-mim.gloss: disjointed letters; meaning deferred to tafsir

ata--hisab.gloss: gift made due by account (editorial gloss)

fa-al-lima-yurid.gloss: Effecter of what He intends (editorial gloss)
